name: looot: score new signups against your ICP

parameters.content:
## Signup qualifier
POST {email} from your app's signup hook.
Free-mail and bad addresses are skipped at $0.
Otherwise looot enriches the person and the company, and the Score node rates them hot, warm or cold. Edit the ICP block in Score.
Cap: $0.05 per job, $0.10 per signup at most.
